high_level_description: Strictly non-photographic, wordless Turkish ebru book-arts illustration: a completed marbled sheet rests safely on a drying board while two practitioners skim every residual pigment from the central water tray before a pristine blank sheet is introduced, using flat mineral color, elegant contours and no photographic modeling, writing or arrows.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A pale cream manuscript-paper field is enclosed by a restrained cobalt and earth-red marbled border, leaving one broad uninterrupted workshop tableau in the center. A flat ochre floor strip anchors all objects without perspective. No architectural room, window, realistic horizon, photographic light, gradient, text, calligraphy, numeral, caption, arrow, diagram, interface, mosque, sacred inscription, national flag or authority platform appears.

elements.desc: Completed rectangular ebru sheet secured upright on a simple wooden drying board at the upper-left, carrying one continuous cobalt, earth-red and olive stone-pattern marbling made from softly combed floating pigments. The pattern exists only on this finished paper; the board has no label, caption, date, signature, stamp, frame ornament, status badge or storage compartment.

Adult ebru practitioner kneeling beside the central tray, medium skin tone, dark hair covered by a plain rust headscarf, cobalt long-sleeve tunic, cream apron and dark trousers. With a calm focused expression, they draw a broad absorbent skimmer continuously across the entire liquid surface, gathering every remaining colored fleck rather than beginning the next sheet prematurely.

Wide shallow rectangular ebru tray occupying the center, outlined in dark brown and filled with pale prepared liquid. One half is already completely clear while a thin gathered band of cobalt, red and olive residue collects against the skimmer on the opposite edge; no finished pattern, paper, label, gauge, drain symbol, interface control or realistic reflection remains inside.

Second adult ebru practitioner kneeling at the lower-right, medium-brown skin, short black hair, cream shirt, olive vest, rust trousers and plain slippers. They hold a clean water pitcher above the cleared end of the tray and keep a pristine blank sheet safely raised in the other hand, waiting until the residual pigment has been fully removed.

Low waste basin at the lower-left receiving the rolled strip of skimmed residual pigment, shown as a compact cobalt, red and olive bundle physically separated from the completed artwork and the waiting blank sheet. The basin is plain dark earthenware with no hazard mark, face, text, number, label, decorative emblem, drain pipe or connection to the drying board.

Pristine cream paper sheet held horizontally above the right side of the scene, completely unmarked and separated from the tray until cleaning finishes. Its straight edges and empty surface contrast with the completed marbling on the drying board; it contains no watermark, alphabet, numeral, diagram, logo, icon, border pattern or transparent digital effect.
